title: ACT ON THE MANAGEMENT AND DISPOSAL OF PROPERTY HELD BY THE STATE OR LOCAL GOVERNMENTS FOLLOWING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE AGREEMENT UNDER ARTICLE IV OF THE MUTUAL DEFENSE TREATY BETWEEN THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA AND THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, REGARDING FACILITIES AND AREAS AND THE STATUS OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES IN THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA
title_original: 대한민국과 아메리카합중국 간의 상호방위조약 제4조에 의한 시설과 구역 및 대한민국에서의 합중국 군대의 지위에 관한 협정의 시행에 따른 국가 및 지방자치단체의 재산의 관리와 처분에 관한 법률
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to provide for special cases concerning the management and disposal of property of the State and local governments furnished to the armed forces of the United States of America following the implementation of the Agreement under Article IV of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America, regarding Facilities and Areas and the Status of United States Armed Forces in the Republic of Korea.

Article 2 (Notification of Decision to Furnish Property and Consultation) When a decision has been made to furnish property belonging to the State or a local government to the armed forces of the United States of America (hereinafter referred to as the "United States") pursuant to Article II of the Agreement under Article IV of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America, regarding Facilities and Areas and the Status of United States Armed Forces in the Republic of Korea (hereinafter referred to as the "Agreement"), the Minister of National Defense shall notify the Minister of Finance and Economy and the head of the central administrative agency or local government having jurisdiction over the relevant property of the decision and shall consult with them concerning measures necessary to furnish that property. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 3 (Management of Furnished Property) Property of the State or a local government furnished to the United States armed forces under Article II of the Agreement shall be managed by the Minister of National Defense during the period of such furnishing.

Article 4 (Transfer of Management)
(1) Upon receiving the notification of the Minister of National Defense under Article 2, the head of the central administrative agency responsible for State property shall, without delay, transfer the right of management of such property to the Minister of National Defense (hereinafter referred to as "transfer of management").
(2) A transfer of management shall be made free of charge, notwithstanding Article 17 of the State Property Act.

Article 5 (Loan Free of Charge)
(1) Upon receipt of a notification from the Minister of National Defense under Article 2, the head of the relevant local government shall, without delay, lend the property to the Minister of National Defense.
(2) The loan of local-government property under paragraph (1) shall be free of charge.

Article 6 (Return)
(1) Where property of the State or a local government managed by the Minister of National Defense under Article 3 is returned by the United States to the Republic of Korea without a reservation as to its future reuse, the Minister of National Defense shall transfer management of the property back to the head of the central administrative agency that originally managed it or return it to the relevant local government: Provided, That if the Minister of National Defense considers continued management necessary for military purposes, the Minister may continue managing the property following consultation with the head of the original central administrative agency and the Minister of Finance and Economy, or with the head of the local government, as appropriate. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
(2) When transferring management of or returning State or local-government property under paragraph (1), the Minister of National Defense shall not be responsible for restoring the property to its original condition.
(3) Article 4 (2) shall apply mutatis mutandis to a transfer of management under paragraph (1).

Article 7 Deleted. <Jul. 14, 2011>

ADDENDA <Act No. 1905, Mar. 3, 1967>
(1) (Enforcement Date) This Act shall apply from the date the Agreement enters into force.
(2) (Transitional Measures) State or local-government property used by United States armed forces at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed to have been transferred for management or lent under this Act, and the procedures prescribed in Articles 4 and 5 shall be completed within 90 days from the date this Act enters into force.

ADDENDA (State Property Act) <Act No. 2950, Dec. 31, 1976>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force four months after its promulgation.
Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Acts)

In Article 4 (2), "Article 14" shall be replaced with "Article 23".
(5) through (7) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Act on Revision of the Building Act and Other Acts Following Changes in Names of Government Ministries, etc.) <Act No. 5454, Dec. 13, 1997>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force six months after its promulgation. <Proviso omitted in the supplied source>
Articles 2 through 9 Omitted.
Article 10 (Amendment of Other Acts)
(1) through (22) Omitted.
(23) Part of the Act on the Management and Disposal of Property of the State and Local Governments Following Implementation of the Agreement under Article IV of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America Regarding Facilities and Areas and the Status of United States Armed Forces in the Republic of Korea shall be amended as follows:
In the heading and paragraphs (1) and (2) of Article 4, the main text of Article 6 (1), and paragraphs (2) and (3) of Article 6, "change of management" shall in each instance be replaced with "transfer of management"; and in Article 4 (2), "Article 23 of the State Property Act" shall be replaced with "Article 17 of the State Property Act".
(24) through (86) Omitted.
Article 11 Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Act No. 10825, Jul. 14, 2011>
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 21065, Oct. 1, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among the Acts amended by Article 7 of these Addenda, provisions amending Acts promulgated before the enforcement of this Act but not yet effective shall enter into force on the respective dates on which those Acts enter into force; and the following amendments shall enter into force on the dates set out in the respective subparagraphs:
1. The amendments specified in the following items shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That among the Acts amended by Article 7 of these Addenda (only insofar as relevant to the amendments in items (a) and (b)), amendments to Acts promulgated before the date on which the main text of this subparagraph enters into force but not yet effective shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Acts.
(a) Amendments to Article 19 (4), Article 23, Article 29 (1) 1, and Article 30.
(b) Amendments to Article 12 (2), Article 19 (3), Article 22, and the proviso of Article 29 (2) (limited to the parts concerning the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Finance and Economy).
(c) Amendments to Acts made under Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to the provisions relating to items (a) and (b)).
2. Omitted in the supplied source.
Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.
Article 7 (Amendment of Other Acts)
(1) through (128) Omitted.
(129) The Act on the Management and Disposal of Property of the State and Local Governments Following Implementation of the Agreement under Article IV of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America Regarding Facilities and Areas and the Status of United States Armed Forces in the Republic of Korea shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 and the proviso of Article 6 (1), the expression "Minister of Economy and Finance" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy".
(130) through (626) Omitted.
Article 8 Omitted.
